data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything stays on this device. No account, no server.
data.persisted: Guaranteed: the browser will not delete Madar data on its own.
data.notPersisted: Not guaranteed: the browser may delete data when space runs low. Back up regularly.
data.unsupported: This browser does not guarantee persistent storage. Back up regularly.
data.usageUnknown: The browser does not report a storage size.
data.tight: Storage is running low. Delete old backups or export files.
data.installWhy: Safari can delete data in a browser tab after 7 days without use. As an app on the Home Screen it is kept.
data.install3: Tap "Add" and open Madar from there.
data.installSeparate: The installed app and the Safari tab have separate storage. To move: export in the tab, import in the app.
data.installAlt: Three steps: tap the Share icon, choose "Add to Home Screen", tap "Add".
data.installReminder: Until Madar is installed: please back up regularly.
data.exportBlocked: Export ready ({size}). This frame does not allow downloads; in the real app the file is saved.
data.importConfirmText: Your current data is saved as a backup first and then replaced by the contents of the file.
data.imported: Imported: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
data.pruned: Old backups deleted. The newest is kept.
data.testText: Creates test data, exports it, imports it again and compares. Your real data is not touched.
data.testOk: All good: saving, exporting and restoring work ({size}, {ms} ms).
data.errorSTORAGE_FULL: Not enough space on the device. Delete old backups or export files and try again. Nothing was changed.
data.errorIMPORT_INVALID: This file is damaged or not a Madar export. Nothing was changed.
data.errorIMPORT_TOO_NEW: This file comes from a newer Madar version. Update the app. Nothing was changed.
data.errorDB_TOO_NEW: The stored data comes from a newer version. Please update the app.
data.errorUnknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Claude works for you: Madar creates jobs, Claude (in chat, keyword "madar") does them, results come back. Madar checks everything and plans on its own. Claude never plans.
jobs.suggestNone: Nothing to request right now. Upload material or practice.
jobs.created: {count, plural, one {# job created} other {# jobs created (packages under 30,000 tokens)}}.
jobs.connText: Without a connection, use copy and paste. With a connection, Madar syncs with Claude automatically.
jobs.codeHint: At least 24 characters. It stays on this device only.
jobs.withReport: Provide learning report for evaluations (progress only)
jobs.syncResult: {up, plural, =0 {Nothing uploaded} one {# job uploaded} other {# jobs uploaded}}, {down, plural, =0 {nothing fetched} one {# result fetched} other {# results fetched}}.
jobs.copied: Copied. Paste the job into Claude and write the keyword "madar".
jobs.copyFail: Copying failed. The job text is shown below; select it yourself.

jobs.retried: New job with the error list created.
jobs.reviewNote: Only a recommendation. Madar does not change the plan.
